_comment: Shared by tools/room/build.py (where each CRT goes) and src/crts.ts (where the camera stops). Site axes in metres: x across, y up, +z toward the door. yaw is the way a CRT faces, in degrees: 0 faces +z, 90 faces +x. keyboard: false leaves out the keyboard where there is no surface in front of the CRT. panel (site only, no re-bake) pins the station text to that point instead of the CRT, to keep the subject in view.
